 Nov 14, 2026, 7:51 PM ET 
Memphis Grizzlies guard Ty Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Saturday's matchup with the Brooklyn Nets due to right hip soreness. This will be his second absence of the season, after upper back soreness kept him out against Sacramento on Oct. 31. Scotty Pippen Jr. (back) is also unavailable, leaving Cam Spencer with a clearer path to handle more of the playmaking. Spencer started the last time Jerome sat and delivered 13 assists in 25 minutes, so another useful all-around opportunity is there Saturday. Jerome's next chance to return comes Monday at Washington. -- Brian Dailisan

 Nov 14, 2026, 9:48 PM ET 
Washington Wizards center Alexandre Sarr (illness) is questionable for Sunday's matchup with the Houston Rockets. The timing is unfortunate after Sarr delivered one of his best performances of the season Thursday, scoring 30 points on 12-for-14 shooting with nine rebounds, two assists, two steals, and one block in a double-overtime loss to Detroit. If the 21-year-old can't go, Deandre Ayton could be the biggest beneficiary in Washington's frontcourt and may see a noticeable bump in minutes after playing just nine Thursday.
